proposals.name: Vinheta de missão
proposals.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished concept image for a countdown screen for the existing Sega Mega Drive game Plaguefall. Landscape 10:7 aspect ratio, a single full-bleed game screen, no physical device, no presentation slide, no exterior labels. Reference image 1 is visual reference for the actual game world: Brazilian sertao ochre courtyard, blue church doorway, dark pixel-art cangaceiro protagonist, copper/rust industrial accents. Reference image 2 is visual reference for existing palette/materials and Portuguese pixel typography, NOT a layout to copy. Design a NEW countdown transition, aesthetically refined with generous negative space. Authentic crisp 16-bit pixel art aligned to an implied 320x224 grid, limited color palette, no gradients, no blur, no modern glossy UI. A legible numeral 3 is the main focus, intended to animate 3 then 2 then 1, then enter gameplay immediately. This is a visual proposal, not a gameplay screenshot; do not include health HUD, gameplay UI, input prompts, progress bars, extra numeric countdowns or buttons. Keep all text sparse and exact. Avoid huge flat orange sheet, ornate busy full-screen frame, illegible decorative type. Direction 1: MISSION VIGNETTE. A calm cinematic pixel-art wide illustration of the church courtyard from reference 1 fills the upper two thirds: ochre walls and desert, recognizable blue church doors, the same small dark cangaceiro silhouette from behind near lower left. Lower third is a restrained dark olive/charcoal title strip with thin copper top edge. On that strip place "PATIO DA IGREJA" small at left and "PREPARE-SE" below it. At right a clean cream digit "3" about 40 native pixels tall, with very small copper corner brackets and three small illuminated cream squares below. Strong editorial balance, environmental identity, attractive detailed pixel landscape, understated high contrast. The composition should be clean, immersive, cohesive with the existing game and feasible for tile-based hardware.
